description: MLB player season stats (hitting or pitching) and bio from the official MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com). Input is the MLB person id; season stats only, no game feed. Free public data, MLB copyright applies. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_mlb_statsapi when you need MLB games for one date from the official MLB Stats API; dev_nba_stats when you need NBA player season statistics, sorted leaderboard: per. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: dev_mlb_stats
